verdict.rationale: A card-issuing platform could plausibly ship a built-in assistant in its dashboard or developer portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an official MCP server for connecting the customer's own external AI agents. That is a developer building block and a separate MCP-server capability, not an assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. No evidence shows Marqeta itself ships a built-in AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
